oeis_A237720_conjecture_ii.conjecture: For every integer \(n>2\), there is a prime \(p<n\) such that \(\lfloor\sqrt{n+p}\rfloor\) is prime.

oeis_A275678_conjecture_ii.conjecture: Every positive integer admits a representation of the displayed form for some nonnegative integers \(k,x,y,z\) satisfying \(x\le z\).

oeis_A275786_conjecture.conjecture: For all positive integers \(n\) and \(m\), \(a(n)=a(m)\) implies \(n=m\).

oeis_A336982_conjecture_3.conjecture: For every prime \(p>7\), let \(S(p)=\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\binom{2k}{k}T_k(2,81)T_k(14,81)\); then modulo \(p^2\), \(S(p)\equiv0\) if \(\left(\frac{-30}{p}\right)=-1\), while \(S(p)\equiv\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)(4x^2-2p)\) if \(\left(\frac2p\right)=\left(\frac p3\right)=\left(\frac p5\right)=1\) and \(p=x^2+30y^2\), \(S(p)\equiv\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)(2p-12x^2)\) if \(\left(\frac p3\right)=1\), \(\left(\frac2p\right)=\left(\frac p5\right)=-1\), and \(p=3x^2+10y^2\), \(S(p)\equiv\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)(8x^2-2p)\) if \(\left(\frac2p\right)=1\), \(\left(\frac p3\right)=\left(\frac p5\right)=-1\), and \(p=2x^2+15y^2\), and \(S(p)\equiv\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)(20x^2-2p)\) if \(\left(\frac p5\right)=1\), \(\left(\frac2p\right)=\left(\frac p3\right)=-1\), and \(p=5x^2+6y^2\), where all displayed representations use integers \(x,y\).

oeis_A352656_conjecture_1.conjecture: For every prime \(p\), positive integer \(r\), and nonnegative integers \(a,b,c\), the superfactorial ratio \(F\) satisfies \(F(ap^r,bp^r,cp^r)\equiv F(ap^{r-1},bp^{r-1},cp^{r-1})^p\pmod{p^{4r}}\).

oeis_A357960_conjecture_2.conjecture: For every prime \(p \ge 3\) and integer \(r \ge 2\), \(a(p^r) \equiv a(p^{r-1}) \pmod{p^{3r+3}}\).

oeis_A363983_conjecture_supercongruence.conjecture: For every prime \(p\ge 5\) and all positive integers \(n,r\), \(a(np^r)\equiv a(np^{r-1})\pmod{p^{3r}}\).

oeis_A377224_conjecture1.conjecture: For every nonnegative integer \(n\), \(a(n)=0\) if and only if \(n=1\), and \(a(n)=1\) if and only if \(n\in\{0,2,3,5,7,14,16,19,37,43,58,61,79\}\).

oeis_A386548_supercongruence_conjecture.conjecture: For every prime \(p \ge 5\) and all positive integers \(n\) and \(k\), \(a(np^k) \equiv a(np^{k-1}) \pmod{p^{2k}}\).

oeis_a000224_conjecture_ordowski.conjecture: For every integer \(n>1\), \(n^2\equiv 1\pmod{a(n)(a(n)-1)}\) if and only if \(n\) is an odd prime.

oeis_a010846_granville_conjecture.conjecture: For every \(\epsilon>0\), \(a(n)\ge (\log n)^{1-\epsilon}\) for all sufficiently large \(n\).

oeis_a011545_conjecture_0.conjecture: For every nonnegative integer \(n\), the interval \((\pi 10^n,\, \pi/\arctan(10^{-n}))\) contains no integer.

oeis_a038771_conjecture_1.conjecture: The limit inferior of \(a(n)/p_{n+1}^2\) is 1, and its limit superior is 2.

oeis_a069004_conjecture_2.conjecture: For every integer \(n>1\), \(\pi(n)\ge a(n)\ge \pi(n)/5\), with \(\pi(2)=a(2)\), \(\pi(10)=a(10)\), and \(a(12)=\pi(12)/5\), where \(\pi\) is the prime-counting function.

oeis_a087571_conjecture.conjecture: There are infinitely many composite numbers \(n\) such that \(a(n) \ne 0\).

oeis_a096535_conjecture_1.conjecture: Every nonnegative integer occurs infinitely often among the values of a(n).

oeis_a100478_conjecture_0.conjecture: For every choice of five positive initial values, a(n) is ultimately periodic.

oeis_a103885_conjecture_0.conjecture: For every integer $m\ge1$, there exist real polynomials $P,Q$ of degree $2m$ such that, writing $b(n)=a(mn)$, for all $n\ge1$ one has $\bigl(\prod_{k=1}^{2m}(2mn+k)\bigr)P(n)b(n+1)+(-1)^m\bigl(\prod_{k=1}^{2m}(2mn-k)\bigr)P(-n)b(n-1)=Q(n^2)b(n)$, with $P(x)=P(1-x)$ and all zeros of $P$ in $[0,1]$, while all zeros of $Q(x^2)$ are real and lie in $[-1,1]$.

oeis_a108129_conjecture_0.conjecture: The first positive integer $n$ for which $a(n)=-1$ is $254602$.

oeis_a113258_conjecture_0.conjecture: There exists an integer \(n>4\) such that \(a(n)\) is a perfect power with base and exponent both greater than 1.

oeis_a119563_conjecture.conjecture: There are infinitely many \(n\ge 0\) for which \(a(n)\) is prime.

oeis_a120424_conjecture_0.conjecture: The even terms have natural density \(1/2\), and infinitely many consecutive pairs differ by \(1\).

oeis_a129365_conjecture_D.conjecture: For every positive integer \(n\) and prime \(p\), \(\operatorname{ord}_p(a(np))=\sum_{i\ge 0}\left\lfloor\frac{\lfloor n/p^i\rfloor}{2}\right\rfloor\).

oeis_a141057_supercongruence_conjecture.conjecture: For every prime $p \ge 5$ and positive integers $n$ and $k$, $a(np^k) \equiv a(np^{k-1}) \pmod{p^{3k}}$.

oeis_a153330_conjecture_2.conjecture: The only occurrences of \(1\), \(6\), and \(16\) are \(a(1)=1\), \(a(2)=6\), and \(a(8)=16\), respectively, and the only occurrences of \(3\) are \(a(4)=a(5)=3\).

oeis_a160324_conjecture_1.conjecture: For every integer \(m>2\), every natural number is a sum of \(m\) polygonal numbers of respective orders \(m+1,\ldots,2m\), each with a nonnegative index.

oeis_a160324_conjecture_3.conjecture: For every positive integer \(k\), there exists a nonnegative integer \(n\) such that \(a(n)=k\).

oeis_a176477_conjecture.conjecture: For every \(n\ge 1\), \(a(n)\) is a positive integer, and \(a(n)\) is odd if and only if \(n=2^m\) for some integer \(m\ge 1\).

oeis_a179524_sun_conjecture_1.conjecture: For every prime \(p\), \(\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}a(k)\) is congruent modulo \(p^2\) to \(4x^2-2p\) if \(p\equiv1,9\pmod{20}\) and \(p=x^2+5y^2\), to \(2x^2-2p\) if \(p\equiv3,7\pmod{20}\) and \(2p=x^2+5y^2\), and to \(0\) if \(p\equiv11,13,17,19\pmod{20}\), where \(x,y\in\mathbb Z\).

oeis_a179524_sun_conjecture_2.conjecture: For every positive integer \(n\), \(\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(20k+17)a(k)\equiv0\pmod n\), and for every odd prime \(p\), \(\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}(20k+17)a(k)\equiv p\left(10\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)+7\right)\pmod{p^2}\).

oeis_a182510_conjecture_density.conjecture: The sets of indices where \(a(n)>0\) and where \(a(n)<0\) have natural densities, and the former density is strictly greater than the latter.

oeis_a189286_conjecture_0.conjecture: For every nonnegative integer \(n\), \(a(n)\) is an integer.

oeis_a190969_conjecture_0.conjecture: For every odd prime \(p\), \(\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{a(4k)\binom{2k}{k}^3}{(-4096)^k}\equiv0\pmod{p^2}\), and the congruence holds modulo \(p^3\) when \(p\equiv1,2,4\pmod 7\).

oeis_a195441_conjecture_set_of_solutions.conjecture: The positive integers \(n\) satisfying \(a(n-1)=\operatorname{rad}(n+1)\) are exactly \(\{3,5,8,9,11,27,29,35,59\}\).

oeis_a206911_conjecture.conjecture: The differences \(a(n+1)-a(n)\) are always 2 or 3, and the ratio of the number of 3s to the number of 2s tends to a limit strictly between 3.5 and 3.6.

oeis_a228425_conjecture_3.conjecture: Every integer \(n>1\) can be written as \(n=x+y\) with \(x,y>0\) and \(p_k(x)+p_{k+1}(y)\) prime, where \(p_m(t)=(m-2)t(t-1)/2+t\), if and only if \(k\in\{3,39,99\}\).

oeis_a234246_conjecture_i.conjecture: For every positive integer \(n\) not dividing \(6\), \(a(n)>0\), and \(a(n)=1\) if and only if \(n\in\{4,5,8,9,12,13,24,33,49\}\).

oeis_a237271_conjecture_2.conjecture: For every \(n \ge 1\), \(a(n)\) is the number of maximal sublists of the divisors of \(n\) in which consecutive terms increase by a factor of at most \(2\).

oeis_a249609_conjecture_1.conjecture: The only values of \(n\) for which \(a(n)=0\) are \(0,1,2,7,\) and \(8\).

oeis_a250131_conjecture.conjecture: Let \(b(1)=2\), \(b(2)=3\), and \(b(n)=a(n-2)\) for \(n\ge3\); every nonunit term of \(b\) not divisible by any earlier nonunit term is prime.

oeis_a263001_conjecture.conjecture: For every \(n>2\), \(a(n)>0\), and \(a(n)=1\) if and only if \(n\in\{1,4,6\}\).

oeis_a263326_conjecture_1.conjecture: For all positive integers \(k\) and \(s\), the numbers \(\sum_{d\mid n}1/(d+k)^s\), as \(n\) ranges over the positive integers, have pairwise distinct fractional parts, and none is an integer.

oeis_a275150_conjecture_2_sun.conjecture: For all positive integers \(a,b,c\) and integers \(i,j,k>1\), infinitely many positive integers are not representable as \(a x^i+b y^j+c z^k\) with \(x,y,z\) nonnegative integers.

oeis_a275471_conjecture.conjecture: For every positive integer \(n\), \(a(n)>0\) if and only if \(n\ne 449\).

oeis_a293833_conjecture.conjecture: For every $n>0$, $a(n)>0$, and $a(n)=1$ if and only if $n=12$.

oeis_a300997_finite_difference_is_one_or.conjecture: For every integer \(n \ge 1\), \(a(n+1)-a(n)\) is either \(1\) or \(2\).

oeis_a319524_conjecture_1.conjecture: There are infinitely many \(n \ge 1\) such that \(a(n)=a(n+1)\).

oeis_a323386_conjecture_1.conjecture: Every term \(a(n)\) is either 1 or a prime.

oeis_a341092_conjecture.conjecture: No row of Pascal's triangle contains an arithmetic progression of more than three coefficients.

oeis_a352373_supercongruence.conjecture: For every prime \(p\ge 5\) and all positive integers \(n,k\), \(a(np^k)\equiv a(np^{k-1})\pmod{p^{3k}}\).

oeis_a356026_conjecture_1_part_b.conjecture: Every positive integer occurs as \(a(n)\) for some positive integer \(n\).

oeis_a358340_conjecture_k4.conjecture: The term \(a(n)\) exists for every positive integer \(n\).

oeis_a361714_conjecture_2.conjecture: For every prime \(p\ge 7\) and integer \(r\ge 2\), \(a(p^r)\equiv a(p^{r-1})\pmod{p^{3r+3}}\).

oeis_a363102_conjecture_1.conjecture: For every \(n \ge 3\), \(a(n)\) is either 1 or prime.

oeis_a368692_conjecture_integrality.conjecture: For every nonnegative integer \(n\), \(a(n)\) is an integer.

oeis_a374265_conjecture_1_boundedness.conjecture: There exists a natural number \(B\) such that \(a(n) \le B\) for every \(n\).

oeis_a383466_conjecture_2.conjecture: For every \(n\), \(a(n)\) remains the maximum when the regular pentagrams are allowed to have arbitrary radii and centers.
